newsitem.title: USA: Cyprus Amax sees higher gold production.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Amax sees higher gold production.

text.p: Cyprus Amax Minerals Co said on Thursday that Amax Gold Inc, its 52.5 percent-owned subsidiary, will increase its gold production significantly during 1997, boosted by its Fort Knox mine and its Kubaka operation.
Cyprus Amax said its gold earnings for the first quarter were $1 million, compared with a $2 million loss for the same period in 1996.
Copper/molybdenum earnings were $87 million, up $1 million from the first quarter of 1996. Copper production rose 40 percent to 241 million pounds, helped by the start-up at El Abra in Chile.
Coal earnings were $25 million, up $3 million from the same period in 1996.
Overall, Cyprus Amax reported net income of $0.56 per share, compared with $0.62 for first quarter 1996.
